messages:
marie: Quick note while onboarding kepler18b-int8: observed deterministic drift after KV compaction on long prefills (~90k). Output changes at the same token offset every run.

tom: steps to repro? any logs?

marie: repro script below, running with runtime:int8-canary. Repro ~80% on my workstation.

marie: ```bash
python tests/kv_long_repro.py --model kepler18b-int8 --prefill tests/data/long_chain_90k.txt --window 65536 --seed 13
```

isha: what's the nature of the drift? key duplication, misordered slots, or RoPE boundary effects?

marie: root cause looks like slot reordering during compaction. Hex dump shows a repeated key ID in adjacent slots after compaction. RoPE values remain stable; attention sees slightly shifted context.

tom: did you try disabling compaction or forcing safe memmove?

marie: yes: compaction off -> no repro. Force-safe-memmove -> drops to 1/50. Fast SIMD path -> ~35/50.

bench-bot: ticket created: RF-3123 [kv-cache, compaction, onboarding, kepler18b, int8].

marie: I pushed a small unit test that crafts overlapping copies and a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8602. The fix tightens overlap detection and falls back for misaligned lanes.

isha: great. once merged run matrix: int8/int4/fp16 x compaction on/off x rotary-mode. Also add golden longprefill to nightly.

marie: will monitor CI and share regression numbers post-merge. Thanks all.
